tooltip.guidedrailways.bogie:
Drives physical trains using rotational power
R-Click track to place, including curves
R-Click beneath a physical carriage to attach
Supply rotational power from above the mount
R-Click with a Wrench to toggle brakes, or select for rerailing when off track
Sneak-R-Click with a Wrench to remove
tooltip.guidedrailways.coupler:
Connects two physical carriages
R-Click both couplers with a Coupling Tool to couple
R-Click a coupled end with a Coupling Tool to uncouple
Coupler heads must be within 2 blocks, with at most 1 block of height difference
Sneak-R-Click with a Wrench to remove
tooltip.guidedrailways.driver_console:
Controls an entire physical train
R-Click to drive, or observe a running Schedule
Sneak-R-Click to open settings; Take Control switches to manual driving
While driving: hold right-click and drag the lever; left-click for emergency braking
Movement left/right selects junctions; Esc leaves without changing the notch
R-Click with a Schedule to insert and run it
Supports destinations, Scheduled Delay and Time of Day conditions
